items.name: OpenAI 6-gigawatt AMD Instinct GPU agreement
items.claim: AMD and OpenAI announced a 6 gigawatt agreement to power OpenAI's next-generation AI infrastructure across multiple generations of AMD Instinct GPUs, with the first 1 gigawatt deployment of AMD Instinct MI450 GPUs set to begin in the second half of 2026.
items.source_excerpt: AMD (NASDAQ: AMD) and OpenAI today announced a 6 gigawatt agreement to power OpenAI’s next-generation AI infrastructure across multiple generations of AMD Instinct GPUs. The first 1 gigawatt deployment of AMD Instinct MI450 GPUs is set to begin in the second half of 2026.

items.name: Meta 6-gigawatt AMD Instinct GPU partnership
items.claim: AMD and Meta agree to a definitive multi-year, multi-generation partnership to deploy up to 6 gigawatts of AMD Instinct GPUs.
items.source_excerpt: AMD and Meta agree to a definitive multi-year, multi-generation partnership to deploy up to 6 gigawatts of AMD Instinct™ GPUs

notes: Two named multi-gigawatt GPU supply agreements (OpenAI, Meta) sourced from AMD's own investor-relations press releases, already stored at data/web/. No disclosed RPO/backlog dollar figure found in the stored 8-K or market fundamentals for AMD.
